status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
purpose: learn when to trust model residuals versus the official market using only already-unseen predictions from earlier dates

stackingSchedule.30to90: official market prior only; no prior OOS stack training exists
stackingSchedule.90to150: train stacker on strict-OOS predictions from dates30to89

wide: normalized JRA official wide market prior
quinella: normalized JRA official quinella market prior

stacker.features: logit of each base probability plus model-minus-market logit residuals

ticketScore: stacked strict-OOS probability multiplied by JRA official odds; wide uses lower bound
nextStageOnlyIfUseful: five-race selection and exact Light allocation must be separately locked before portfolio evaluation
